meta.name: Quality control
meta.about: Every safeguard on what enters HAX, generated from the workflow files on each repo's default branch, so only checks that are merged and running appear: 24 blocking gates, 5 advisory checks, 12 scheduled jobs and 7 Claude scheduled tasks. Planned tiles are open pull requests. Element test suites include axe accessibility tests where an element has them; whole-project accessibility is covered by the weekly sweep, not a blocking gate.

qg_block.desc: 24 checks that fail a pull request when they fail, in at least one repo; whether a failing check stops the merge is up to each repo's branch rules. Each is read from the repo's workflow files on its default branch, so only checks that are merged and running appear.

qg_adv.desc: 5 checks that run on pull requests but don't stop a merge (continue-on-error, warning only or report only), plus 3 planned checks still in open pull requests. ESLint stays here until it blocks.

qg_sched.desc: 12 GitHub Actions jobs on a schedule and 7 Claude scheduled tasks. Nothing auto-merges: every PR waits for review, and every flag lands in the unified issue queue.

q_element_api_snapshot.desc: The front-end API of authorable elements doesn't change, so all content ever made keeps working. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_script_tests.desc: The repo's build and maintenance scripts keep working. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_stylelint.desc: CSS follows the stylesheet rules. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_test_all_elements.desc: Every element's test suite passes in Chromium; element suites include axe accessibility tests where an element has them. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_format_check.desc: Formatting stays consistent (Prettier). Reports without failing the pull request in webcomponents. Fails the pull request when it fails in create, haxcms-nodejs.

q_lint.desc: Code follows the repo's lint rules, such as no optional chaining in webcomponents. Fails the pull request when it fails in create, haxcms-nodejs, webcomponents.

q_gallery_build.desc: The component gallery still builds. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_cla.desc: Every contributor has signed the contributor license agreement. Fails the pull request when it fails in create, haxcms-nodejs, haxcms-php, issues, praw, webcomponents.

q_codeql.desc: Code with known vulnerability patterns doesn't merge. Fails the pull request when it fails in create, haxcms-nodejs, haxcms-php, webcomponents.

q_color_contrast_light_and_dark.desc: Text in the demos of the elements a pull request touches meets WCAG AA contrast in light and dark mode. Known failures are baselined, and the baseline can only shrink. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_ddd_token_lint.desc: Only real DDD design tokens are referenced, and the token export stays current. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_audit.desc: Dependencies with known security advisories are caught. Reports without failing the pull request in haxcms-php, webcomponents. Fails the pull request when it fails in create, haxcms-nodejs.

q_pseudo_locale_and_rtl_layout.desc: Changed elements still lay out with long pseudo-locale strings and right to left. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_unused_code_knip.desc: Unused files, exports and dependencies are found. Reports without failing the pull request in webcomponents.

q_memory_leaks.desc: Changed elements don't leak memory when added and removed. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_dependency_licenses.desc: No dependency under an incompatible license enters the repo, and the project stays Apache-2.0. Fails the pull request when it fails in create, haxcms-nodejs, haxcms-php, webcomponents.

q_locale_guard.desc: Feature PRs change English strings only; translations come from the nightly job. Reports without failing the pull request in webcomponents.

q_render_benchmarks.desc: Render performance of changed elements is measured on the PR. Reports without failing the pull request in webcomponents.

q_template_lint.desc: CSS and HTML templates inside elements are well formed. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_walkthrough_status.desc: Element walkthroughs are flagged when the element they show has changed. Fails the pull request when it fails in webcomponents.

q_build.desc: The project still builds. Fails the pull request when it fails in create, haxcms-nodejs.

q_unit_and_api_conformance_tests.desc: Changes don't break existing behavior. Fails the pull request when it fails in haxcms-nodejs.

q_e2e.desc: End-to-end flows in the real UI keep working. Reports without failing the pull request in haxcms-nodejs.

q_performance_and_memory_budgets.desc: Memory, page load and outline save time stay inside the budgets in test/perf/budgets.json. Opt-in: runs on a pull request only when it is labeled perf, and then fails it when the check fails.

q_phpstan.desc: New PHP static-analysis errors don't merge. Fails the pull request when it fails in haxcms-php.

q_phpunit.desc: Changes don't break existing behavior. Fails the pull request when it fails in haxcms-php.

q_unit_tests.desc: Changes don't break existing behavior. Fails the pull request when it fails in create.

q_security_lint.desc: Unsafe patterns (eval, shell injection and the like) don't merge into the CLI. Fails the pull request when it fails in create.

q_smoke_tests.desc: A fresh install can create a site, add a page and serve it. Fails the pull request when it fails in create.

qp_haxcms_nodejs_240.desc: In an open pull request, not running yet.

qp_haxcms_php_779.desc: In an open pull request, not running yet.

qp_create_130.desc: In an open pull request, not running yet.

q_build_and_tests.desc: Runs nightly in webcomponents, nightly in haxcms-nodejs, nightly in haxcms-php, nightly in create. webcomponents: last scheduled run 2026-11-10, success; haxcms-nodejs: last scheduled run 2026-11-10, success; haxcms-php: last scheduled run 2026-11-10, failure; create: last scheduled run 2026-11-10, success.

q_codeql_sched.desc: Code with known vulnerability patterns in main is caught, including patterns found after it merged. Runs nightly in webcomponents, nightly in haxcms-nodejs, nightly in haxcms-php, nightly in create. webcomponents: last scheduled run 2026-11-10, success; haxcms-nodejs: last scheduled run 2026-11-10, success; haxcms-php: last scheduled run 2026-11-10, success; create: last scheduled run 2026-11-10, success.

q_audit_sched.desc: Dependencies with known security advisories are caught. Runs nightly in webcomponents, nightly in create. webcomponents: last scheduled run 2026-11-10, success; create: last scheduled run 2026-11-10, success.

q_unused_code_knip_sched.desc: Unused files, exports and dependencies are found. Runs weekly in webcomponents.

q_dependency_licenses_sched.desc: No dependency under an incompatible license enters the repo, and the project stays Apache-2.0. Runs weekly in webcomponents, weekly in haxcms-nodejs, weekly in haxcms-php, weekly in create.

q_mutation_testing.desc: The tests catch real faults: deliberate mutations of the code must make them fail. Runs weekly in webcomponents, weekly in haxcms-nodejs.

q_openssf_scorecard.desc: Supply-chain security practices are scored (OpenSSF Scorecard). Runs weekly in webcomponents, weekly in haxcms-nodejs, weekly in haxcms-php, weekly in create. webcomponents: last scheduled run 2026-11-09, success; haxcms-nodejs: last scheduled run 2026-11-09, success; haxcms-php: last scheduled run 2026-11-09, success; create: last scheduled run 2026-11-09, success.

q_parity.desc: haxcms-nodejs and haxcms-php give the same results for the same operations. Runs nightly in haxcms-nodejs, nightly in haxcms-php. haxcms-nodejs: last scheduled run 2026-11-10, failure; haxcms-php: last scheduled run 2026-11-10, failure.

q_performance_and_memory_budgets_sched.desc: Memory, page load and outline save time stay inside the budgets in test/perf/budgets.json. Runs weekly in haxcms-nodejs.

q_fresh_install_smoke_test.desc: A fresh install can create a site, add a page and serve it. Runs nightly in create. create: last scheduled run 2026-11-10, success.

q_old_site_compatibility.desc: Sites made from 2021 on keep working: one fixture site per year is upgraded to the latest code and edited the way an author would. Runs weekly in create.

q_parity_harness_nodejs_php_cli.desc: The same seeded operations sent to haxcms-nodejs, haxcms-php and the HAX CLI write the same sites (report only). Runs nightly in create.

ct_translations.desc: Claude scheduled task, nightly. New and changed English strings reach every language, in one rolling PR. Scheduled, but no output on GitHub yet.

ct_docs.desc: Claude scheduled task, weekly. Element docs and demos keep up with their properties and HAXSchema; broken links are fixed. Ecosystem web PRs in praw start once the graph data lives there. Scheduled, but no output on GitHub yet.

ct_whatsnew.desc: Claude scheduled task, weekly. Merged changes people would notice are drafted as What's New and Tips entries. Running and producing output.

ct_tours.desc: Claude scheduled task, weekly. Element walkthroughs are redrafted when an element's surface changes; approved ones are listed for review. Scheduled, but no output on GitHub yet.

ct_a11y.desc: Claude scheduled task, weekly. Element demos are checked with axe in light, dark and reduced motion; clear fixes come in one rolling PR. Scheduled, but no output on GitHub yet.

ct_sweep.desc: Claude scheduled task, weekly. Stale and duplicate issues, stale PRs and branches, bot job health and agent drift are flagged in one report. Flag only. Running and producing output.

ct_fuzz.desc: Claude scheduled task, nightly. Seeded property-based tests look for inputs that break the CLI, haxcms-nodejs and webcomponents (https://github.com/haxtheweb/issues/issues/3272). Running; it only produces output when it finds something.

tours.label: What guards a change
tours.message: Every safeguard on what enters HAX, read from the CI that actually runs.

scenes.caption: 24 blocking gates: a pull request can't merge until these pass.
5 advisory checks report on the pull request without stopping it.
Planned checks, still in open pull requests.
Scheduled GitHub Actions run nightly and weekly against main.
Claude scheduled tasks take the jobs that need judgment: translating, docs, triage. Not producing output yet: Nightly translations, Documentation pass, Element tours, Accessibility sweep.
